{{Top|leg}}
A '''sound chip''' was a recording device capable of storing and playing recorded sounds. A sound chip was once used by an individual to fake the presence of [[Breshig]] [[trill beast]] in a [[T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Alamintari]]''. In reality, they were smuggling ten [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of [[Garcornian spice]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> Sound chips were also used inside [[Quay novelty toy]]s, where they had a number of pre-recorded answers encoded onto them.<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
